analytic.limitations: Known horizontal carriers are an artificial task; false-band/peak metrics quantify residual energy, not a complete hallucination detector. GPU FP16 results are not exact replay of earlier CPU FP32 neural scores. Full photo/real/GFX review remains required.

native_visual_review.interpretation: Both neural outputs remain close: fabric strands are largely lost, leaves waxy and building detail soft. V56 does not visibly strengthen fence wires; channel-RawNIND retains a colored grid. Both analytic carrier examples remain attenuated; fixed-display flats show no obvious new structure. This 8-bit view does not exclude small false detail. The ISO100 capture is independently sharper and differs in optics and time; it is not exact GT.

decision: Stop V56 at first1000 without promotion or continuation. Natural-photo and known-primary scores decline, weak-carrier gains are mixed and native review shows no clear detail advantage. Keep the input adapter defaultFalse and V43 step2000 README reference. Complete state remains on the original planned4000 schedule. Next perform an identical-source/same-seed V54 control replay to measure procedural repeatability, not training-seed variance. No convergence or universal architectural failure claim.

evaluation_replay.interpretation: Analytic neural FP16 replay is not bit exact across independent runs; cause not isolated. Shared CPU observations have exact Malvar metrics. Use newly recomputed matched controls, without claiming exact replay of prior analytic neural values.
